name: Magical Missy Launch
source:
I wish that everything could stay the way it is, and that no one I love has to be sad again."

After opening a mysterious yet cute box, bad things has been happening to her friends. Its up to Missy to stop this with her newfound magical powers! ...and with a missile launcher?!

[From [url=https://charlesplush.itch.io/magicalmissylaunch]Itch.io[/url]]
